notes.title: 1.0.4 Update!
notes.content:
1.0.4 fixes:
-Minor UI fixes.
-UI now adjusts to different screen size ratios.
-New developer console cheats.
-Removed shoot cooldown after sprinting.
-Added outer walls to Chasm deathmatch level.
-Fixed problem in the Level Map where pressing the same input on two different control devices at the same time disabled all controls.
-Mouse cursor now becomes visible on Level and Deathmatch Victory screens.
-Revamped mouse aiming when using KBM controls.
-Crosshairs are now colored to match chosen tank color.
-Added trails to crosshairs and aiming lasers.
-Dying while laying a mine no longer will make you stuck in the middle of laying mine animation.
